from pathlib import Path
paths=['/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/tests/regression/ba-issues/issues/issue-3513/iwasm_poc_04.wasm','/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/tests/regression/ba-issues/issues/issue-3514/iwasm_poc_05.wasm','/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/tests/regression/ba-issues/issues/issue-3346/test.wasm']
def read_u32leb(data,i):
    res=0; sh=0; start=i
    while True:
        b=data[i]; i+=1; res|=(b&0x7f)<<sh
        if not b&0x80: break
        sh+=7
    return res,i
for p in paths:
    data=Path(p).read_bytes(); print('\n',p,len(data),data[:8].hex())
    i=8
    while i<len(data):
        sid=data[i]; i+=1; size,i=read_u32leb(data,i); body=i; end=i+size
        print(' section',sid,'size',size,'off',body)
        if sid==1:
            j=body; n,j=read_u32leb(data,j); print('  types',n)
            for t in range(min(n,10)):
                flag=data[j]; j+=1; pc,j=read_u32leb(data,j); params=data[j:j+pc]; j+=pc; rc,j=read_u32leb(data,j); rets=data[j:j+rc]; j+=rc; print('   type',t,'pc',pc,params.hex(),'rc',rc,rets.hex())
        if sid==3:
            j=body; n,j=read_u32leb(data,j); print('  funcs',n,[read_u32leb(data,j := j)[0] for _ in []])
            arr=[]
            for k in range(n): v,j=read_u32leb(data,j); arr.append(v)
            print('   typeidx',arr[:20])
        if sid==10:
            j=body; n,j=read_u32leb(data,j); print('  codes',n)
            for f in range(min(n,5)):
                sz,j=read_u32leb(data,j); cs=j; ce=j+sz; lcnt,j=read_u32leb(data,j); locals=[]
                for _ in range(lcnt): c,j=read_u32leb(data,j); typ=data[j]; j+=1; locals.append((c,typ))
                code=data[j:ce]; print('   func',f,'size',sz,'locals',locals,'code',code[:200].hex())
                j=ce
        i=end
